test_title: Delhi Police Constable (Executive) 2023 - Numerical Ability (Held on: 01 Dec, 2023 Shift 1)
subject: maths
question: A person got a new chair at 35% discount. Had he got no discount, he would have had to pay ₹224 more. What is the marked price (in ₹) of the chair?
solution:
**Given:**

A person got a new chair at 35% discount.

Had he got no discount, he would have had to pay ₹224 more.

**Formula Used:**

Discount = Marked Price × Discount Percentage

Discount Amount = Marked Price - Selling Price

Calcul
